content.short: The Kingfisher offers the most accurate liquidations maps in the crypto industry.
content.description: The Kingfisher provides original future liquidation maps to help you forecast where crypto asset prices may move and the timing of price action. If you want to reduce slippage and improve your entry and exit accuracy, or increase your overall trading success, The Kingfisher is for you. We pioneered forecasting market liquidations and now deliver data through indicators such as GEX+, ToxicOrderFlow, and LiqMaps (liquidations maps), offering a unique view of the crypto markets' hidden liquidity.
content.meta: The Kingfisher offers original future liquidation maps showing price directions. Discover The Kingfisher and other Trading Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
